claims.location: comment[data file] and comment[fraction identifier] all rows
claims.value: 46 human TMT fractions, fr01-fr46, each represented for 8 reporter channels
claims.evidence: All 46 deposited RAW file names with ARCV_fr01 through ARCV_fr46, exactly one per numbered fraction. The other 12 RAW runs have distinct 20201211 PRI names and are outside this partial artifact.

claims.value: 126 Ctrl1; 127N Ctrl2; 127C Ctrl3; 128N ARVC1; 128C ARVC2; 129N ARVC3; 129C ARVC4; 131C ARVC5
claims.evidence: PRIDE sampleProcessingProtocol explicitly lists eight TMT label/sample assignments. Processed workbook Ttest(ARVC vs Ctrl) has Ctrl1-3 and ARVC1-5 columns.
Human right-ventricular endomyocardial biopsies in paper and PRIDE protocol.

claims.value: normal for three controls; arrhythmogenic right ventricular cardiomyopathy for five cases
claims.evidence: PRIDE explicit label map names Ctrl1-3 and ARVC1-5; paper Figure 3 states five ARVC and three control heart samples; processed workbook Ttest(ARVC vs Ctrl) confirms these same eight identities.
No donor-to-TMT-channel age, sex or ancestry map is deposited. Paper provides only cohort-level clinical ranges.

claims.location: comment[instrument], acquisition method, dissociation, collision energy
claims.value: Orbitrap Exploris 480; DDA Top10; HCD; 30 NCE
claims.evidence: PRIDE dataProcessingProtocol states the 46 fractioned TMT peptides were measured on Orbitrap Exploris 480 using Top10 HCD and normalized collision energy 30%.

claims.location: two repeated comment[cleavage agent details] columns
claims.evidence: PRIDE sampleProcessingProtocol explicitly says 2 h Lys-C followed by overnight trypsin. Bundled reconcile inspects only first repeated cleavage column and produces a false incomplete warning.

limitations: This SDRF is only the 46-file human TMT fraction subset of a 58-RAW-file PXD. The 12 mouse 20201211 runs require separate sample-to-condition mapping and are not claimed here.

PRIDE sampleProcessingProtocol has an apparent copied HCM/MYBPC3 sentence inconsistent with the project title, explicit ARVC channel map, processed workbook and primary paper. Case disease follows the latter three concordant sources.
Individual donor ages, sexes, ancestry and exact PKP2 allele are not mapped to reporter channels.
Search modification parameters and mass tolerances are omitted or not available because the accessible primary deposit metadata does not specify them.
